fact: Egypt's National Health Strategy 2024–2030 names the unified electronic medical record under its digital health priority, with the Ministry of Health and Population as implementer: hospitals of all service providers are to be automated to align with it and all primary care units automated to support it, in UHI and non-UHI governorates alike, and a National Digital Health Strategy with timelines and budget allocations is to be finalised; it states that fully electronic medical records are implemented in PHC centres in UHI governorates and that 70-80% of hospital processes are automated.
title: Egypt National Health Strategy 2024 - 2030
publisher: Ministry of Health and Population, Arab Republic of Egypt
